datasets.product_name: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic (M20_JezeroCrater_CTXDEM_20m)
datasets.limitations: 20 m posting; cannot resolve boulders or sub-pixel roughness; stereo artefacts possible near steep walls
datasets.usage: USGS/NASA planetary data, public domain; cite USGS Astrogeology and the CTX team (Malin et al. 2007)
datasets.verification: Filename, extent (Jezero), size and CRS match the USGS product; checksum vs. USGS server not compared

datasets.processing: GDAL DEMProcessing slope, Horn (1981) 3x3, scale=1 (metre/metre), degrees; bit-identical to independent recomputation
GDAL DEMProcessing hillshade, Horn, azimuth 315, altitude 45, z=1, scale=1

datasets.origin: Exported from Jezero_Final_Terrain_Stats.gpkg (not present in this workspace)
datasets.limitations: Prototype study regions, not NASA hazard zones; geometry was reconstructed/repaired per original metadata

datasets.product_name: M20_JezeroCrater_CTXortho_mosaic_5m.tif (companion orthomosaic to the CTX DEM)
datasets.note: Large file; download only after confirming need. Hillshade used as basemap meanwhile.

datasets.product_name: SIM 3464 Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars (Sun & Stack 2020)
datasets.note: Distributed as ~349 MB Esri file geodatabase in a different projection; needs reprojection to Jezero_Crater_Projection
Rover localization tables; the m20_orbital_dem.img/m20_orbital_map.img data files referenced by the labels are not present

datasets.processing: Existing backend rover_track(500) stride sampling; first retained coordinate checked against published Mars longitude/latitude
datasets.limitations: Historical NASA PDS rover localization records, not live tracking or science-target observations.

datasets.processing: Maximum class over source pixels: NoData > other exclusions > steep > transparent
datasets.limitations: Display-only source-resolution constraints. Steep >15°; other = cost outside [1,100) or negative slope. NoData is unassessed, not a confirmed hazard. Router uses its own resampled grid; no individual rocks or simulated closures are shown.

datasets.processing: Bilinear imagery / nearest valid-data mask, reprojected to DEM preview grid
datasets.limitations: Partial CTX coverage; transparent outside the source footprint. Original TIFF CRS/transform used, not the unregistered JPEG or viewer center coordinates.
